findings.title: A form-level validation problem whose only field error has pointer "" (e.g. the new D-068 validation.json for an invalid-UTF-8 body) is shown twice in RecordForm: the same localized message appears in two role="alert" regions, in English and Arabic
findings.reproduction: Candidate 9331e9d1 (source cf3446e4), qa-stack (real SPA + API + PostgreSQL), chromium-en and chromium-ar. qa-verifier spec docs/delivery/test-evidence/DG2/qa/tests/round-8/e2e/dg2-qa-r8.spec.ts R8-05: on the charter page, click Create, fill Out of scope, and submit while the browser's POST /charter body carries two invalid UTF-8 bytes (FF FE) inside the value. The real server answers 400 problem+json code validation, errors [{pointer:"", code:"validation.json"}] (correct per D-068). The form then shows 'The request was not valid JSON.' / 'الطلب ليس بصيغة JSON صالحة.' TWICE (screenshots en-/ar-qa-r8-05-charter-invalid-utf8-server.png). Cause (40-f340-duplicate-alert-static.log): in apps/web/src/components/RecordForm.tsx the pointer-"" field error is not mapped to a field, so it goes to `other` (the data-state="form-errors" alert). setBannerError(e) then renders errorMessage(), which in apps/web/src/lib/problem.ts returns the same field-error text for a validation problem whose first error has pointer "" (the data-state="error" alert). The de-duplication on that line only skips codes equal to e.code or validation.<e.code>. The logic dates from bfa1807 (round 4); it is not a D-068 regression. The normal SPA cannot produce such a problem (it always sends valid UTF-8 JSON), so users reach it only through tampered or proxied requests or other pointer-"" validation codes.
findings.expected: One alert per distinct message: a form-level validation problem shows its localized message once (and a screen reader announces it once), in both English LTR and Arabic RTL.
findings.actual: The identical message is rendered in two adjacent role="alert" regions, so it is visually duplicated and announced twice. No data is written, the status and code are correct, and axe reports no serious or critical violation. Polish only.

history.note: Raised by qa-verifier in DG2 round 8 (T-DG2-REV-QA-R8) while regression-testing D-068 in the UI. Low and non-mandatory: a duplicated, correctly localized message on a path the normal SPA does not produce; nothing is written and the server behaviour is correct. Pre-existing RecordForm logic (bfa1807), surfaced by the new validation.json path.
